fresh_population.source: new natural Gen 9 Random Battle decision corpus
fresh_population.source_binding: SHA-256 of decisions.jsonl plus exact workflow head SHA

enriched_stratum.rule: union of states in the top quartile of each varying numeric predictor frozen from PR #46: legal_action_count, incoming_ko_roll_probability_gap, opponent_public_hp_fraction, or hidden_item_entropy_bits; invariant numeric predictors contribute no enrichment
enriched_stratum.quartiles_computed_from: fresh admissible population before any policy value is computed

representative_lower_stratum.rule: deterministic SHA-256 sample from admissible states outside the enriched stratum
representative_lower_stratum.purpose: retain a lower-predictor comparison rather than replacing prevalence with targeted search

cohort_selection.target_ratio: 2 enriched : 1 representative-lower when both strata have sufficient support
cohort_selection.binary_predictors: persistent_protect_present and persistent_switch_present remain measured predictors and association strata, but do not define enrichment because persistent-only candidate admission makes at least one true by construction

paired_treatment.deeper_extension: one additional public observation and player decision before leaf utility

primary_endpoints: max root-action determinization value minus public-belief value at each depth
corrected public-belief regret of the determinization-chosen root action at each depth
paired deeper-minus-shallow change in value bias
paired deeper-minus-shallow change in corrected regret
decision_rule: choose later mechanics expansion only from measured deeper-search residuals and predictor strata; do not require or optimize for a root-policy flip
valid_falsifications: deeper search does not increase value bias
deeper search increases value bias but corrected regret remains zero
deeper search produces neither corrected regret nor policy disagreement

inference.primary_analysis: paired state-level deeper-minus-shallow changes with battle-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals

reason: three states from two battles are too sparse for the planned paired population inference
the original enrichment rule was logically degenerate because persistent-only admission guarantees Protect or persistent-switch presence for every candidate
numeric predictors should enrich only when they discriminate within the fresh admissible population
amendment: increase the fresh source population from 256 to 1024 battles
use only varying numeric PR #46 predictors for enriched-cohort selection
retain Protect and persistent-switch presence as measured predictors rather than automatic enriched-stratum membership
require at least 8 selected states from at least 6 battles before exact policy values may be evaluated

reason: the full 8-by-8 nested continuation treatment exceeded the bounded interactive experiment budget before any exact shard produced an outcome
the frozen cohort itself passed all preregistered support criteria and must not be regenerated or reselected in response to runtime
amendment: reuse the exact same 18-state frozen cohort
retain 8 root chance samples and chance seed family 0
reduce continuation chance samples from 8 to 2 for both shallow and deeper treatments
retain one versus two public continuation-decision horizons as the only search-depth difference
bound each exact shard to 30 minutes

reason: the exact two-horizon treatment was spending most execution time replaying generator variants that differ only in hidden moves or Tera type
the bounded opponent policy always replays one publicly observed response move and never terastallizes
item, ability, level, EVs, IVs, and exact HP remain materialized because they affect mechanics
amendment: marginalize prior mass across generator variants that share species, ability, item, level, EVs, and IVs before exact-HP expansion
retain one representative full set only to instantiate Showdown for each execution class
fail closed if the fixed public opponent response ever becomes unavailable and would require consulting hidden fallback moves
retain the preregistered 8 root and 8 continuation chance samples unchanged
